title: Signal Record
$comment: Refined for V2 Phase 1 (BL-014, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md). Zero live Signal records exist (data/signals/ is empty). The refinement target is the six staged, not-yet-imported blueberry proposed Signals (data/imports/blueberry-public-pilot-2026-08-03/signals/), per docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md's Signal section. COMPATIBILITY CORRECTION (found by running the existing test suite, not by data inspection alone): app/main.py's live /signals route validates against this schema at runtime (get_validator('signal.schema.json')) and has its own independent, hard-coded id-generation convention (new_signal_id() always produces a 'signal-' prefix) and form-option vocabularies (SIGNAL_STRENGTHS = [low, medium, high], SIGNAL_STATUSES = [active, watch, resolved]) -- checking only data/ for backward compatibility (0 live signal records) missed this second, equally-real compatibility surface. An id-pattern or enum replacement that only served the blueberry package's shape would have permanently broken live signal creation without any app/template code being touched, which is exactly the 'do not change application behavior' constraint this task set. Resolved by making id pattern and the strength/status enums the UNION of both vocabularies -- not a replacement -- so both the live app's existing values and the blueberry package's proposed values validate. evidence_ids' minItems 1->2 is kept exactly as specified (not unioned/loosened): it was an explicit, deliberate BL-014 requirement, not an incidental value mismatch, and the live app's existing multi-value evidence_ids form field already supports satisfying it with zero app/template changes -- see the test update noted in this task's final report.

id.$comment: Union, not a replacement: 'signal-' is what app/main.py's new_signal_id() always generates today (unchanged, not touched by this task); 'sig-' is what the staged blueberry signals and their own proposed-schema-enhancements.md P-7 use.

direction.$comment: Demoted from required to optional: the staged blueberry signals don't populate it, but the live app always does when creating one, with these exact values (SIGNAL_DIRECTIONS in app/main.py, unchanged) -- concept and value set both retained.

strength.$comment: Union, not a replacement: [low, medium, high] is app/main.py's SIGNAL_STRENGTHS (unchanged, drives the live form's dropdown); [weak, moderate, strong] is the staged blueberry signals' and P-7's vocabulary. Still required -- both sides always populate it.

confidence.$comment: Demoted from required to optional: the staged blueberry signals don't populate it, but the live app always does. Value set unchanged.

status.$comment: Union, not a replacement: [active, watch, resolved] is app/main.py's SIGNAL_STATUSES (unchanged, drives the live form's dropdown); [proposed, monitoring, confirmed, refuted, retired] is docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md's adopted state machine, matching all six staged signals (status=proposed). [disputed, deferred, dismissed] added for Corroboration + Signal Formation (2026-08-19): app/services/signal_candidates.py's human-review decisions (CONFIRM/EDIT/DEFER/DISMISS/MARK DISPUTED) needed a status a reviewer could actually land a Signal candidate on beyond confirmed/refuted -- disputed is distinct from refuted (a refuted Signal has been shown wrong; a disputed one has a live, unresolved contradiction in its own supporting Evidence), and deferred/dismissed give a reviewer a real 'not yet' or 'no' short of forcing a premature confirm/refute.

evidence_ids.$comment: Raised from 1 to 2 (BL-014, kept exactly as specified): a signal is a pattern across multiple evidence, not a single data point. All six staged signals have 4-5 evidence_ids. This does change what the live /signals form will accept (a single-evidence submission now fails validation, where it previously succeeded) -- flagged explicitly in this task's final report, not silently absorbed; the existing form field already accepts multiple comma-separated evidence ids with zero app/template changes needed to satisfy it.

berry_ids.$comment: V2 Phase 2A (D-012, docs/v2/08-DECISION-LOG.md). Formalizes a field every live Signal record already sets in practice (all 6 imported signals populate berry_ids) but that was never declared in this schema before now -- previously valid only because this schema has no additionalProperties:false restriction. This is Signal's own market-scope field, kept under its existing name rather than renamed to match Assessment/Recommendation's market_ids for cosmetic consistency (D-012's own reasoning: renaming a working field with live data serves no new capability). Optional, not required, so any future non-Berries Signal without a berry concept still validates.

domain_ids.$comment: V2 Phase 2A (D-012). Explicit analytical scope -- which Domain(s) this Signal applies to, for consistency with Assessment/Recommendation's scope fields. Optional and additive; absent or empty means not yet explicitly declared. See docs/v2/PHASE-2-REPOSITORY-REQUIREMENTS.md Part 2.5.

geography_ids.$comment: V2 Phase 2A (D-012). Geography entity id(s) this Signal's pattern is explicitly scoped to, when narrower than the full domain/market. Optional and additive.

first_seen.$comment: Demoted from required to optional: the staged blueberry signals don't populate it (they use an unmodeled proposed_at field instead), but the live app always does.

last_updated.$comment: Demoted from required to optional: the staged blueberry signals don't populate it, but the live app always does.

reviewer.$comment: Made nullable (was a required non-empty string) to accommodate reviewer=null on all six staged, not-yet-human-reviewed signals. The live app always sets a real, non-empty string, which remains valid under this looser type.

does_not_prove.$comment: Corroboration + Signal Formation addition (2026-08-19), optional. Carries the same discipline evidence.schema.json's does_not_prove already applies to a single record onto a multi-evidence Signal: a developing pattern across sources (e.g. a patent grant plus trade coverage) may suggest something (increased IP activity) without proving a further claim (commercial launch, acreage, strategic intent). Explicit and human-readable so source_authority/information_confidence on the underlying Evidence is never silently read as signal-level proof.

source_independence.$comment: Corroboration + Signal Formation addition (2026-08-19), optional. app/services/source_independence.py's independence_report() output at the time this Signal was proposed or last reviewed -- how many of evidence_ids' records actually trace to distinct origins, not just how many records there are (three reprints of one press release must never silently read as three independent confirmations). Informational, not authoritative: a human reviewer may override the pattern this implies, but the computed clustering itself is never edited in place, only recomputed.
